subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: After atomic terminalization is fixed, should this staged durable wake/replay foundation ship in beta3 before its downstream internal-delivery consumer?
rationale: The correctness repair is mechanical, but adopting a broad persistent core subsystem and choosing its staged release boundary require maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix and sponsor the stack
options.body: Repair atomicity, refresh upgrade proof, land the foundation first, and then merge this layer.

options.title: Hold for end-to-end review
options.body: Keep this layer open until the production delivery consumer can be reviewed with the replay foundation.

options.title: Defer durable beta3
options.body: Do not land the dependent stack without explicit product sponsorship and release ownership.

recommendation.title: Fix and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Repair atomicity, refresh upgrade proof, land the foundation first, and then merge this layer.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history signal for the shared-state and adjacent agent-runtime surfaces involved in this release-level choice.
